description: Tests that the routing system uses the current operational authority for present-day routing while retaining the notified Greater Mysuru City Corporation status as transition information.

scenarios.reason: Mysuru City Corporation is the current operating municipal authority for its present jurisdiction.
An expansion-area locality must be routed using its current operational local authority rather than automatically treating the notified Greater Mysuru City Corporation as operational.
The Greater Mysuru City Corporation record is retained as a notified/future transition authority and must not be treated as the current operating authority without an effective operational status.

note: This test file is for application testing. Exact locality-level expected authorities should be taken from the MySQL jurisdiction mapping rather than invented coordinates.
